snippet.title: Loot Gobblin' Together Announcement Trailer | Game Access 2026
snippet.description:
An online co-op game where you and your friends play greedy gobblins invading human houses to steal and gobble loot. Climb, stretch, and manage your stamina to survive chaotic heists and feed your Gobblin King.

Wishlist the game! https://store.steampowered.com/app/4651490/Loot_Gobblin_Together/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=launch
